import importlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
packages={}
for name in ('torch','numpy','typing_extensions'):
 m=importlib.import_module(name);p=Path(m.__file__).resolve();assert p.is_relative_to(root)
 packages[name]={'version':getattr(m,'__version__',None),'path':str(p)}
import torch
assert torch.__version__.split('+')[0]=='2.13.0' and torch.cuda.is_available()
print(json.dumps({'executable':sys.executable,'base_prefix':sys.base_prefix,'packages':packages,'pytorch_cuda':torch.version.cuda,'gpu':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)},indent=2))
print(subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,driver_version,compute_cap','--format=csv'],text=True))
print(subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_gpu_memory','--format=csv'],text=True))
